newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota shares hit record high on repurchase report.
newsitem.headline: Toyota shares hit record high on repurchase report.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp shares rose to a record high in the Thursday afternoon session, boosted by a media report that the firm was planning a share repurchase, brokers said.
As of 0512 GMT, the shares were 120 yen higher at 3,560. Trade volume totalled 6.03 million shares, making it the second most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
The evening edition of the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said Toyota is planning to conduct a share buy-back in July or later, after the plan is approved at a shareholders meeting scheduled for late June.
The cost of the share repurchase, the company's second, is likely to be similar to or larger than the first repurchase, in which up to 100 billion yen worth of shares was bought, the paper said.
Toyota officials declined to comment on the report.
